senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; זָגַג, cmp. מֶמֶר fr. מָרַר) [clearing, refining; fr. which מָזַג to clear (dark) wine by dilution &c.,]
mixture. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 5, ch. VII לא במ׳ not in a mixture of water and wine.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:7">Nidd. II, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Niddah 19a">19ᵃ</cite>) <he>וכמ׳</he> Y. a. Bab. ed. (Mish. <he>כמזוג</he>), v. <cite ref="M00712"><he>מָזַג</he></cite>. Y. ib. II, 50ᵇ top <he>וכמ׳ אבא … מזוג נראה מבחוץ</he> (not <he>וכמזגי</he>) ‘and like mixed wine’, says Abba …, like a cup filled with mixed wine, seen from without (through the glass). Bab. ib. 20ᵃ <he>חוץ ממ׳</he> except the discharge which has the color of a mixture of one third wine &c.; a. e.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:5">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>מִזְגּוֹ … רע</he> (not <he>רעה</he>) the king’s disposition is bad (he is illiberal).
